findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and secondary strain evaluated separately, and coordinate control only.

The observed support window is the learning window [0.0, 0.5] with observed score times at 0.01 spacing from 0.0 to 0.49, and curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so selection preference in this window is not evidence of measured final affinity benefit.

The coordinate representation is native model endpoint world coordinates, and the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a real FLOWR endpoint VJP; no affinity-head derivative or extra production forward is used.

limitations: No per-feature selection contrast, survival, or endpoint effect rows were retrieved in this session; the query for endpoint effects on soft_mass features returned zero matched records, so no signed coordinate candidate with population and support can be stated.
Selection preference within the observed window is not descendant survival and not measured final affinity benefit; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies.
No current-study outcome data are available to this role, so no absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient can be inferred from any contrast or its time derivative.
Untyped coordinate proxies are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation; no such interpretation is offered.
